title: Two Segments
description: A pipeline trial: somebody asks for a talk show with two segments, and gets one.
question: Is two segments enough?

worked: The engine reads in the cold open: a wish, a beat, then "Built it."
didnt: Nearly ten minutes is too long for a weekly show

keep: The Ask and "Built it." in the cold open

change.why: a trial of the shortest show the format allows

experiment.what: Cut the episode to two segments and no song
experiment.why: to see whether the show still reads as itself at its shortest
experiment.success: the reviewer can name the show's engine from the cold open alone

inherit.why: the pilot's cold open, as a reference for the Ask's timing; nothing is imported from it

descriptor: a man who is mostly air

overrides.middle-format: a pipeline trial; the panel is the simplest guest segment to render
